allowed_claim: The project has a generated knowledge-gap plan: MC005 needs reliability/transfer closure, MC006 needs a margin-decoupled predecision lever or timing closeout, the bridge and familiar-entity levels need materially new substrates, and real uncertainty is still below the behavior gate.

classification_rule.hidden_state_permission: A level may license new hidden-state work only after behavior, null, locality, holdout, and output/candidate gates pass.
classification_rule.linked_work_orders: Only existing offensive-doctrine work orders are linked; future substrates are marked new_work_order_required.
classification_rule.plan_level: One missing-evidence plan per predeclared knowledge-ladder level.

forbidden_claim: This plan does not establish a truth or knowledge vector, a promoted knowledge mechanism, a reliable MC006 steering route, or a real-world factual correction/refusal/uncertainty mechanism.

decision_rules.containment_rule: If the primary effect survives but nulls remain fragile, keep MC005 as a bounded synthetic lookup reference, not a general knowledge mechanism.
decision_rules.death_rule: Kill the write-replacement route if null flips or collateral side effects persist across the fixed repair variants.
decision_rules.export_rule: Export NULL_ROW_LOW_MARGIN_FLIP, TRANSFER_PRIMARY_BEFORE_RELIABILITY, or TRANSFER_PRIMARY_FAILED as reusable diagnostics.
decision_rules.promotion_rule: Promote only if high-margin lookup mediation stays strong and the answer-absent null boundary closes under locality, side-row, fluency, and holdout panels.

forbidden_moves: Do not describe MC005 as full reliability while answer-absent null flips remain.
Do not call a primary-effect replication transfer unless null locality and side-effect panels also transfer.
Do not broaden the claim to knowledge control.
level_plans.insight: The best current mechanism-like object is also the best calibration object for how reliability boundaries break.
level_plans.label: Pure synthetic lookup

missing_evidence.description: Repair or explicitly bound the answer-absent low-margin null flips without weakening the high-margin lookup mediation claim.
Measure whether primary mediation, null locality, side effects, and prompt robustness transfer together beyond the current Qwen-dominant setting.
Decide whether write replacement is promoted, bounded, or killed after a fixed repair budget.

level_plans.next_allowed_action: Use the MC005 reference closeout and transfer-width probe. Do not keep adding same-route repairs unless the preregistered repair budget changes the reliability boundary.

work_order_links.containment_rule: The surviving claim may say source-value attention-write mediation exists in the tested lookup contract; it may not say full reliability, transfer, or general knowledge control.
work_order_links.export_rule: Export NULL_ROW_LOW_MARGIN_FLIP and MODEL_SIZE_NULL_FRAGILITY as named reliability diagnostics if promotion fails.
work_order_links.iteration_budget: Two serious repair variants, then promote, bound, or kill.
work_order_links.kill_rule: Kill the write-replacement route if null flips or side effects persist across two materially different local intervention variants.
work_order_links.promotion_rule: Promote only if lookup mediation remains strong and answer-absent null flips disappear or fall below a predeclared trivial threshold across locality, side-row, and holdout panels.
work_order_links.title: Force a verdict on the MC005 internal-causal reference specimen.

work_order_links.containment_rule: A primary-effect replication is not a transferred mechanism unless reliability and null fields move beyond bounded.
work_order_links.export_rule: Export TRANSFER_PRIMARY_BEFORE_RELIABILITY or TRANSFER_PRIMARY_FAILED as the widening diagnostic.
work_order_links.iteration_budget: One bounded/reference row plus one diagnostic row before more deepening.
work_order_links.kill_rule: Kill the transfer route for a surface if two model-family or prompt-family tests reproduce the same reliability failure.
work_order_links.promotion_rule: Promote a transfer claim only if primary effect, null locality, side effects, prompt-contract robustness, and holdouts all transfer.
work_order_links.title: Make transfer failure or success measured instead of assumed.

decision_rules.containment_rule: Until then, the level only says familiar entities are a bridge stressor, not a localizable control surface.
decision_rules.death_rule: Kill same-family MC007-style repairs if the behavior remains parse-, authority-, or prompt-contract-dominated.
decision_rules.export_rule: Export PROMPT_AUTHORITY_CONFUND or BEHAVIOR_TABLE_CONDITION_CONFOUND if the next substrate fails for visible reasons.
decision_rules.promotion_rule: Promote this level only when a familiar-entity behavior substrate passes direct, null, prompt-channel, holdout, and output/candidate gates before probing.

forbidden_moves: Do not run hidden-state probes on another MC007-style behavior failure.
Do not treat real entity names as knowledge evidence when the artificial value contract is unstable.
Do not reuse the same authority-dial route as a new substrate.
level_plans.insight: This level is where semantic familiarity first enters, and current evidence says the behavior contract fails before mechanism work.
level_plans.label: Semi-synthetic familiar entities

missing_evidence.description: A familiar-entity task where local artificial values are behaviorally stable before hidden-state work.
Prompt-authority, format, source-disjoint, null, and output/candidate baselines that do not explain the behavior.
A panel that measures whether familiar entity priors help, conflict with, or swamp task-local lookup.

level_plans.next_allowed_action: Treat MC007 as blocked under the current substrate. A future attempt needs a materially new familiar-entity contract before any signature search.

work_order_links.containment_rule: The surviving claim is a behavior-contract diagnostic about bridge failure modes; no hidden signature or mechanism claim is licensed.
work_order_links.export_rule: Export POST_MC032_BRIDGE_ROUTE_CLOSED, FACT_CLAIM_MISMATCH_LOCAL_AND_CLAIM_LEAK, and STATUSLESS_SOURCE_VALIDITY_LOCAL_DOMINANCE as diagnostics.
work_order_links.iteration_budget: Route closed after MC033 unless a new bridge substrate class is preregistered.
work_order_links.kill_rule: Kill same-family repairs after MC033; do not add another source-validity cue unless it changes the substrate class, not just the wording of the reliability cue.
work_order_links.promotion_rule: Promote a future bridge substrate to hidden-state work only if it is materially outside MC007-MC033 and branch, null, local, side-number, parseability, prompt-channel, source-disjoint, and output/candidate controls pass together.
work_order_links.title: Close the post-MC033 bridge substrate family before any hidden-state work.

decision_rules.containment_rule: The current bridge evidence supports a substrate-failure taxonomy, not a symbolic or learned-memory mechanism.
decision_rules.death_rule: Keep the MC007-MC033 same-family route killed unless a new proposal changes the substrate class, not merely the cue wording.
decision_rules.promotion_rule: Promote a bridge level to hidden-state work only if a materially new substrate clears all behavior, null, locality, holdout, and output/candidate gates together.

forbidden_moves: Do not start probes on MC031-MC033-style rows.
Do not reopen status labels, row codes, operation handles, worked examples, answer schemas, absence guards, checksum, consistency, or row-local fact-claim cues.
Do not call a prompt-visible positive control a knowledge mechanism.
level_plans.insight: The bridge ladder is not an embarrassing absence of mechanisms; it is a map of which bridge substrates die under controls.
level_plans.label: Symbolic / learned-memory bridge

missing_evidence.description: A bridge substrate outside MC007-MC033 that passes branch, null, local, side-number, parseability, prompt-channel, source-disjoint, and output/candidate controls.
A documented gate allowing hidden-state work only after the bridge behavior substrate is clean.
Evidence that learned/local arbitration remains stable across conflict mixtures instead of collapsing to prompt-visible or output-visible cues.

level_plans.next_allowed_action: Close the same-family bridge route after MC033. A future bridge must be a new substrate class, not another source-validity cue.

work_order_links.containment_rule: The surviving claim is a behavior-contract diagnostic about bridge failure modes; no hidden signature or mechanism claim is licensed.
work_order_links.export_rule: Export POST_MC032_BRIDGE_ROUTE_CLOSED, FACT_CLAIM_MISMATCH_LOCAL_AND_CLAIM_LEAK, and STATUSLESS_SOURCE_VALIDITY_LOCAL_DOMINANCE as diagnostics.
work_order_links.iteration_budget: Route closed after MC033 unless a new bridge substrate class is preregistered.
work_order_links.kill_rule: Kill same-family repairs after MC033; do not add another source-validity cue unless it changes the substrate class, not just the wording of the reliability cue.
work_order_links.promotion_rule: Promote a future bridge substrate to hidden-state work only if it is materially outside MC007-MC033 and branch, null, local, side-number, parseability, prompt-channel, source-disjoint, and output/candidate controls pass together.
work_order_links.title: Close the post-MC033 bridge substrate family before any hidden-state work.

decision_rules.containment_rule: If the route fails, keep MC006 as a decision-timing and output-visibility result, not a truth or knowledge vector.
decision_rules.death_rule: Kill final-token MC006 probing if another margin-matched pass is explained by candidate score or final output margin.
decision_rules.export_rule: Export FINAL_STATE_OUTPUT_VISIBLE or PREDECISION_MONITOR_NO_LEVER depending on where the controlled failure lands.
decision_rules.promotion_rule: Promote to intervention only if an earlier source/path signal predicts on holdout while beating same-stage output geometry and final candidate margin.

forbidden_moves: Do not steer V15/V16-style final-token perfect AUCs.
Do not treat final margin as a nuisance if it is the faithful downstream decision state.
Do not use lonely AUCs without same-stage and final-stage baselines.
level_plans.insight: MC006 is valuable because it measures where knowledge-like behavior becomes output-visible, even without a usable lever.
level_plans.label: Strong parametric fact override

missing_evidence.description: An earlier signal that survives same-stage output geometry, final candidate margin, shuffle, and source-disjoint holdout controls.
A steering or editing route that changes generated capital-fact override behavior before answer commitment without broad collateral effects.
A measured boundary for whether MC006 has usable lead time or is already output-visible by the final decision state.

level_plans.next_allowed_action: Use the MC006 predecision frontier closeout. Probe earlier positions only under same-stage and final-margin controls; do not steer final-position high-AUC signatures.

work_order_links.containment_rule: The allowed claim becomes decision timing for capital-fact override, not a truth or knowledge vector.
work_order_links.export_rule: Export FINAL_STATE_OUTPUT_VISIBLE or PREDECISION_MONITOR_NO_LEVER depending on where the failure lands.
work_order_links.iteration_budget: One margin-matched early-position pass; no final-position reruns unless they change the control geometry.
work_order_links.kill_rule: Kill final-prompt-token probing for MC006 if another margin-matched pass remains candidate-score or final-margin explained.
work_order_links.promotion_rule: Promote to intervention only if an earlier signal predicts the behavior on source-disjoint holdout while beating same-stage output geometry, final candidate margin, and shuffle controls.
work_order_links.title: Turn MC006 final-margin failure into a decision-timing result.

decision_rules.containment_rule: Until then, this level remains a future target and cannot support factual correction, refusal, or uncertainty mechanism claims.
decision_rules.death_rule: Kill any uncertainty route whose labels or refusal behavior are explained by prompt wording, answer schema, or output margin.
decision_rules.export_rule: Export BEHAVIOR_TABLE_CONDITION_CONFOUND, REQUESTED_MODE_CONFOUND, or OUTPUT_MARGIN_CONFUND if the substrate fails.
decision_rules.promotion_rule: Promote this level to signature search only after real uncertainty behavior passes behavior, prompt, output, label-balance, null, and holdout gates.

forbidden_moves: Do not probe hidden states on MC002/MC002B as if they were mechanism-ready.
Do not collapse factual correction, refusal, and uncertainty into one label before the behavior table passes.
Do not publish a real-world abstention control claim from synthetic or prompt-visible behavior.
level_plans.insight: The real safety-relevant level is still below the behavior gate; that is a result about the current map, not a reason to pretend the ladder is higher.
level_plans.label: Real abstention / uncertainty

missing_evidence.description: A balanced generated-answer table for factual correction, refusal, or uncertainty behavior that passes prompt, label, and output-margin controls.
Null rows, side-effect checks, fluency, locality, and holdouts that distinguish abstention from formatting or refusal-template artifacts.
A label source for known, unknown, corrected, unsupported, and abstain cases that does not leak through prompt text or answer interface.

level_plans.next_allowed_action: Open a new behavior-family work order only after the behavior table is clean. Hidden-state work is not licensed for the current MC002/MC002B substrates.
